tasks.title: Clear engineering parked backlog when dispatch pauses
tasks.summary: Hourly recover-queue self-heals first (cancel resolved/superseded gap-closure parks; unpark healed preflight_clash) before the cap-8 pause/email. Queue auto-resumes when count drops below 7 and 30 minutes have elapsed since the last clearing action. Separate from project-traffic pause (stuck CI/conflict PRs).
